name: SPAR scores for India
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c:Country {iso_code: 'IND'}) WHERE e.year = 2023 RETURN e.capacity_code, e.capacity_name, e.score ORDER BY e.capacity_code

name: SPAR scores for Nigeria
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c:Country {iso_code: 'NGA'}) WHERE e.year = 2023 RETURN e.capacity_code, e.capacity_name, e.score ORDER BY e.capacity_code

name: Top 10 countries by surveillance capacity
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c:Country) WHERE e.capacity_code = 'C05' AND e.year = 2023 RETURN c.name, e.score ORDER BY e.score DESC LIMIT 10

name: Countries with lowest lab capacity
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c:Country) WHERE e.capacity_code = 'C04' AND e.year = 2023 RETURN c.name, e.score ORDER BY e.score ASC LIMIT 10

name: Average SPAR score per country (2023)
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c:Country) WHERE e.year = 2023 WITH c, round(avg(e.score)) AS avg_spar, count(e) AS capacities RETURN c.name, avg_spar, capacities ORDER BY avg_spar DESC LIMIT 10

name: Countries with lowest avg SPAR
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c:Country) WHERE e.year = 2023 WITH c, avg(e.score) AS avg_spar RETURN c.name, avg_spar ORDER BY avg_spar ASC LIMIT 10

name: India SPAR trend over years
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c:Country {iso_code: 'IND'}) WITH e.year AS year, round(avg(e.score)) AS avg_score RETURN year, avg_score ORDER BY year

name: Capacity gap: risk communication below 40
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c:Country) WHERE e.capacity_code = 'C10' AND e.year = 2023 AND e.score < 40 RETURN c.name, e.score ORDER BY e.score ASC LIMIT 10

name: Count countries per SPAR year
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c:Country) WITH e.year AS year, count(DISTINCT c) AS countries RETURN year, countries ORDER BY year
